טבלה: אחריות מקצועית - יועצי השקעות
This table lists specific exclusions to the professional liability insurance policy for investment advisors. It details events or losses that are not covered by the policy.
ממדים: Specific exclusion to the insurance coverage, Description of the exclusion

Specific Additional Exclusions to this Extension
Loss caused by an identifiable employee of the Assured or by a person in collusion with any employee of the Assured .
Loss of potential income, including but not limited to interest and devidends.
Indirect or Consequential Loss of any nature.
Liability assumed by the Assured by agreement under any contract unless such liability would have attached to the Assured even in the absence of such agreement.
Loss  resulting  directly  or  indirectly  from  the  accessing  of  any  confidential  information including  but  not  limited  to  trade  secret  information,  computer  programs  or  customer information.
Loss resulting directly or indirectly from forged, altered or fraudulent negotiable instruments, securities, documents or written instruments.
Loss of negotiable instruments, securities, documents or written instrument
Loss resulting from mechanical failure, faulty construction, error in design, latent defect, wear  or  tear,  gradual  deterioration,  electrical  disturbance, Electronic  Data  Processing Media failure  or  breakdown  or  any  malfunction  or  error  in  programming  or  errors  or omissions in processing.
Any claims arising from any internet operations or activities.
The  Insurer's  liability  under  this  part  shall  be  limited  to  the  limits  of  indemnity  as mentioned in the schedule but in no event shall exceed $ 1,000,000 any one occurrence and in the aggregate.
